Small comedic facial overlays are placed on his pectorals. (3) The man, now shirtless and wearing a black baseball cap, carefully pours steamed milk into a ceramic cup to create latte art. The setting is a dimly lit, modern cafe with industrial decor. (4) A woman with long pinkish-orange hair, wearing a pink and white checkered blazer, stands outside the cafe's window counter, gesturing excitedly. (5) In a different outdoor setting, a man in a brown and teal utility jacket looks around suspiciously before zipping his coat. (6) A montage shows various individuals in masks and eccentric costumes dancing in a brightly lit room with a TV screen in the background. (7) Back at the cafe, the woman in the pink blazer tastes the coffee, her facial expression showing intense delight as digital exclamation marks appear near her head.
